_about: Zoning cells (PRD, "M2 Zoning and buildings"). Every zonable segment gets square cells along both sides, reaching back from the road's edge. `maxSlope` is the steepest ground, rise over run at a cell's centre, that a cell can be zoned on. It is a starting value to tune, a little steeper than the steepest street (0.16), since a building can step down ground a road cannot climb. No prices here, so no source years.
